title: Practitioners who hold a Department controlled substance registration
rule_summary: 105 CMR 700.004(A)(2) provides that the following practitioners are required to be registered under 105 CMR 700.004(A)(1) and shall register separately for each business or professional activity: Certified Nurse Practitioner; Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist; Dentist; Nurse Midwife; Optometrist; Pharmacist; Physician; Physician Assistant; Podiatrist; Psychiatric Nurse Mental Health Clinical Specialist; and Researcher. An individual pharmacist therefore holds a registration issued by the Department in his or her own right, and holds it separately for each business or professional activity, even though the pharmacy that employs the pharmacist registers with the Board of Registration in Pharmacy.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate keeps the pharmacy's Board registration apart from the individual pharmacist's Department registration, since a duty that 105 CMR 700.000 addresses to a registrant reaches the pharmacist personally.
common_confusions: A pharmacist is on the list of practitioners in 105 CMR 700.004(A)(2), so the conclusion that a retail drug business registers with the Board does not mean that nobody in the pharmacy holds a Department registration.
The registration is required separately for each business or professional activity rather than once for the individual.
verification_notes: Read in the official 105 CMR 700.004(A)(2) text published at mass.gov on 2026-09-12. Added as a new rule so that no released adjudication is disturbed.
